import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv(r'C:\Users\fitch\claude-projects\georgia-power-rsrch\large-loads-reports\outputs\combined\pipeline_projects.csv')

# Projects with large load jumps between consecutive quarters (potential false matches)
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['proj_id','report_quarter'])
df_sorted['prev_load'] = df_sorted.groupby('proj_id')['announced_load_mw'].shift(1)
df_sorted['load_ratio'] = df_sorted.apply(
    lambda r: min(r.announced_load_mw, r.prev_load) / max(r.announced_load_mw, r.prev_load)
    if pd.notna(r.prev_load) and r.prev_load > 0 else None, axis=1)

suspicious = df_sorted[(df_sorted.load_ratio < 0.5) & df_sorted.match_confidence.str.startswith('ramp')].sort_values('load_ratio')
print(f'Ramp-matched rows with >2x load change: {len(suspicious)}')
if not suspicious.empty:
    print(suspicious[['proj_id','report_quarter','match_confidence','announced_load_mw','prev_load','load_ratio','project_stage']].head(10).to_string(index=False))

print()
# Overall confidence distribution
print('Match confidence distribution:')
conf_group = df.match_confidence.str.extract(r'^(\w+)')[0].value_counts()
print(conf_group)

print()
# Projects with 5+ quarters of continuous tracking

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_projects.csv')
df_changes = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_changes.csv')

QUARTER_ORDER = ['2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2024Q4','2025Q1','2025Q2','2025Q3','2025Q4','2026Q1']

# Our count: project_age == 1, excluding seed quarter
our_added = (df[(df['project_age'] == 1) & (df['report_quarter'] != '2024Q1')]
             .groupby('report_quarter').size().reindex(QUARTER_ORDER[1:], fill_value=0))

# GP's count
gp_added = df_changes.set_index('report_quarter')['added_projects'].reindex(QUARTER_ORDER)

# Our removed: set-difference consecutive quarters
removed_counts = {}
quarters = [q for q in QUARTER_ORDER if q in df['report_quarter'].unique()]
for i in range(1, len(quarters)):
    prev_q, curr_q = quarters[i-1], quarters[i]
    prev_ids = set(df[df['report_quarter'] == prev_q]['proj_id'])
    curr_ids = set(df[df['report_quarter'] == curr_q]['proj_id'])
    removed_counts[curr_q] = len(prev_ids - curr_ids)

our_removed = pd.Series(removed_counts).reindex(QUARTER_ORDER, fill_value=0)
gp_removed = df_changes.set_index('report_quarter')['removed_projects'].reindex(QUARTER_ORDER)

print('=== ADDED projects comparison ===')
comp = pd.DataFrame({'GP_reported': gp_added, 'Our_count': our_added, 'Diff': our_added - gp_added})
print(comp.to_string())

print()
print('=== REMOVED projects comparison ===')
comp2 = pd.DataFrame({'GP_reported': gp_removed, 'Our_count': our_removed, 'Diff': our_removed - gp_removed})
print(comp2.to_string())
"
description: Compare our added/removed counts against GP's reported figures

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_projects.csv')
LOAD_COLS = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('load_')]

# Confirm P0038/P0064 are truly identical in Q1 (duplicate entries)
p38 = df[(df['report_quarter']=='2024Q1')&(df['proj_id']=='P0038')][LOAD_COLS].values[0]
p64 = df[(df['report_quarter']=='2024Q1')&(df['proj_id']=='P0064')][LOAD_COLS].values[0]
p72 = df[(df['report_quarter']=='2024Q2')&(df['proj_id']=='P0072')][LOAD_COLS].values[0]
print('P0038 ramp:', p38.tolist())
print('P0064 ramp:', p64.tolist())
print('P0072 ramp:', p72.tolist())
print('P0038==P0064:', (p38==p64).all(), '  P0064==P0072:', (p64==p72).all())

print()

# Check the Q3 revised filing - compare load ramps of Q2 'lost' exact matches to Q3 'new' same-load projects
pairs = [
    ('P0166','2025Q2','P0232','2025Q3'),  # CES 240MW Q4 2025
    ('P0164','2025Q2','P0233','2025Q3'),  # CES 240MW Q1 2025
    ('P0063','2025Q2','P0236','2025Q3'),  # CES 180MW Q3 2026
    ('P0021','2025Q2','P0238','2025Q3'),  # CES 180MW Q1 2026
]
print('Q2->Q3 missed exact matches (same announced_load + service_date, different proj_id):')
for p_q2, q_q2, p_q3, q_q3 in pairs:
    r2 = df[(df['report_quarter']==q_q2)&(df['proj_id']==p_q2)]
    r3 = df[(df['report_quarter']==q_q3)&(df['proj_id']==p_q3)]
    if r2.empty or r3.empty: continue
    r2, r3 = r2.iloc[0], r3.iloc[0]
    ramp2 = [r2[c] for c in LOAD_COLS]
    ramp3 = [r3[c] for c in LOAD_COLS]
    ramp_match = ramp2 == ramp3
    print(f'  {p_q2} ({q_q2}): {r2[\"project_stage\"]}, {r2[\"announced_load_mw\"]}MW, {r2[\"initial_service_date\"]}, territory={r2[\"territory\"]}')
    print(f'  {p_q3} ({q_q3}): {r3[\"project_stage\"]}, {r3[\"announced_load_mw\"]}MW, {r3[\"initial_service_date\"]}, territory={r3[\"territory\"]}')
    print(f'  ramp identical: {ramp_match}')
    print()

# Summary of discrepancy by quarter
print('Net project count discrepancy per quarter (our_added-our_removed vs GP_added-GP_removed):')
df_changes = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_changes.csv')
QUARTER_ORDER = ['2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2024Q4','2025Q1','2025Q2','2025Q3','2025Q4','2026Q1']
quarters = [q for q in QUARTER_ORDER if q in df['report_quarter'].unique()]
for i in range(1, len(quarters)):
    prev_q, curr_q = quarters[i-1], quarters[i]
    prev_ids = set(df[df['report_quarter'] == prev_q]['proj_id'])
    curr_ids = set(df[df['report_quarter'] == curr_q]['proj_id'])
    our_added = len(df[(df['report_quarter']==curr_q)&(df['project_age']==1)])
    our_removed = len(prev_ids - curr_ids)
    gp_row = df_changes[df_changes['report_quarter']==curr_q]
    gp_added = int(gp_row['added_projects'].values[0]) if not gp_row.empty else 0
    gp_removed = int(gp_row['removed_projects'].values[0]) if not gp_row.empty else 0
    phantom = our_added - gp_added  # = our_removed - gp_removed (should be ~equal)
    print(f'  {curr_q}: our +{our_added}/-{our_removed} vs GP +{gp_added}/-{gp_removed}  | phantom pairs: {phantom}')
"

import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
import openpyxl
from copy import deepcopy

# Replicate the removal logic for Q3 to see if P0166 gets removed from working
SCRIPT_DIR = Path('scripts')
WORKBOOKS_DIR = Path('outputs/workbooks')

def norm_load(v):
    try:
        return int(round(float(v))) if v is not None else None
    except:
        return None

def find_header_row(rows):
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        if any(c and re.search(r'project.?(name|stage)', str(c), re.IGNORECASE) for c in row):
            return i
    return None

# Load Q3 removed projects sheet
qdir = WORKBOOKS_DIR / '2025Q3'
xlsxs = list(qdir.glob('*.xlsx'))
print('Q3 workbook:', xlsxs[0].name if xlsxs else 'NOT FOUND')
if not xlsxs:
    sys.exit(1)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(xlsxs[0], read_only=True, data_only=True)
print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames)

sheet_map = {s.lower(): s for s in wb.sheetnames}
if 'removed projects' in sheet_map:
    ws = wb[sheet_map['removed projects']]
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    hi = find_header_row(rows)
    print('\\nRemoved Projects sheet (header row', hi, '):')
    print('Header:', rows[hi] if hi is not None else 'not found')
    removed_loads = []
    if hi is not None:
        for row in rows[hi+1:]:
            if row[0] is None: continue
            load = norm_load(row[1])
            if load is not None:
                removed_loads.append(load)
    print('Removed loads:', sorted(removed_loads))
    print('240 in removed loads:', 240 in removed_loads)
    print('180 in removed loads:', 180 in removed_loads)
"

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_projects.csv')
df_ch = pd.read_csv('outputs/combined/pipeline_changes.csv')

QO = ['2024Q1','2024Q2','2024Q3','2024Q4','2025Q1','2025Q2','2025Q3','2025Q4','2026Q1']
qs = [q for q in QO if q in df['report_quarter'].unique()]

def gp(q, col):
    r = df_ch[df_ch['report_quarter']==q]
    return int(r[col].fillna(0).values[0]) if not r.empty else 0

print('New projects (age = 1, excluding seed quarter):')
print(f'  {\"Quarter\":<10} {\"GP\":>5} {\"Ours\":>5} {\"Diff\":>5}')
for i, q in enumerate(qs):
    gp_n = gp(q, 'added_projects')
    our_n = 0 if i == 0 else len(df[(df['report_quarter']==q)&(df['project_age']==1)])
    print(f'  {q:<10} {gp_n:>5} {our_n:>5} {our_n-gp_n:>+5}')

print()
print('Removed projects:')
print(f'  {\"Quarter\":<10} {\"GP\":>5} {\"Ours\":>5} {\"Diff\":>5}')
for i in range(1, len(qs)):
    pq, cq = qs[i-1], qs[i]
    our_r = len(set(df[df['report_quarter']==pq]['proj_id']) - set(df[df['report_quarter']==cq]['proj_id']))
    gp_r  = gp(cq, 'removed_projects')
    print(f'  {cq:<10} {gp_r:>5} {our_r:>5} {our_r-gp_r:>+5}')
"
